git_commit_status: UNAVAILABLE: git commands reported this directory is not a Git repository.
baseline_public_claims: PATL is a local v0.1 alpha trust layer.
PATL provides deterministic ALLOW, ALLOW_WITH_LOG, REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION, and BLOCK decisions.
PATL evidence events avoid raw private content by default.
Mock demos are synthetic and do not connect to real accounts.
baseline_known_p0_issues: Confirmation was bound only to request_id and user flag, not full canonical request digest, nonce, or expiry.
A request that returned REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION was consumed by replay detection before confirmation could be retried.
Agent stack identity checks did not cover model_id, tool_id, or agent_version request metadata.
Evidence ledger was append-only in memory but not hash chained.
baseline_known_p1_issues: Schema validation tests checked JSON syntax but not Draft 2020-12 validation of runtime input.
No public case study or standards crosswalk.
immutability_note: This file records observed Day-1 baseline facts before new sprint result claims. It must not be rewritten to improve later results.
